features.quote: Stop when any of the following occurs: maximum attempts reached, maximum wall-clock time reached, token budget reached, model explicitly states it cannot proceed, no new code changes are proposed for N consecutive attempts
Use a fixed cap, e.g.: 6 to 10 attempts per run. This is enough to observe repeated-failure dynamics without making the session so long that every model eventually becomes exhausted.
features.justification_quote: enough to observe repeated-failure dynamics without making the session so long that every model eventually becomes exhausted
